dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides extensive expert knowledge not commonly known: exact default values, attribute keys, health‑checker IP origin, case‑sensitivity of paths, matcher defaults, TLS handling, deregistration delay semantics, slow‑start behavior, Lambda health‑check specifics, weighted routing mechanics, cross‑zone nuances, stickiness effects, proxy protocol and preserve‑client‑ip implications, ECS grace period, least‑outstanding‑requests algorithm, enhanced CloudWatch metrics, and recent 2024‑2026 feature updates.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes senior‑engineer mindset with a precise diagnostic order, AWS‑specific probes (describe‑target‑health, security‑group checks, attribute reads) and clear decision‑tree flow. Minor omission: no explicit procedure for verifying listener‑protocol compatibility before health‑check probing.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: The NEVER list is extensive and reasoned, but it omits some common pitfalls such as NACL mis‑configurations, IAM permission errors on describe calls, and over‑permissive logging that can mask health‑check failures.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter, description, when‑to‑use, activation triggers and invocation schema are present and well‑formed; however the activation_triggers list is overly exhaustive, risking false activations in ambiguous contexts.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The skill provides a top‑level quick‑start then deep sections, but the initial document front‑loads a large amount of tables, philosophy and anti‑patterns before the core decision tree, creating some cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom precisely: read‑only probes first, mandatory CONFIRM before any state‑changing CLI, limits batch remediation, and distinguishes fragile operations from safe ones.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: The skill follows a recognizable pattern (quick‑start → mindset → philosophy → decision tree → anti‑patterns → remediation), but the mixture of prose, tables and code blocks makes the overall structure slightly ad‑hoc.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI probes, decision branches and output format, enabling an agent to act. Missing are explicit handling of malformed inputs beyond the generic INSUFFICIENT_DATA block and guidance for environments lacking VPC‑level curl access.
